author: "The elder", traditionally John
authorNote: Traditionally John the apostle. The author calls himself "the elder" in 2 and 3 John; scholars debate whether this is the apostle or another John.
audience: "The chosen lady and her children", probably a church
overview: A very short letter urging love and warning not to welcome teachers who deny that Jesus came in the flesh.
storyPlace: One of three letters of John.
